_planner_rationale: in-dist T3: recipes/tornado.json IS the answer — the recipe encodes the two structural facts param reasoning cannot supply: (1) the funnel is painted by a SWEPT-ANGLE emitter expression (triangle-wave height, radius growing with height, 12 rev/s merges coils into a wall — World Rotation does NOT orbit particles), (2) Particular auto-uses the comp camera, so a 3D camera rig supplies the perspective
reused verbatim including motion blur 200 shutter and dense 40k psec dust wall; only naming + two-frame sampling changed
renderFrames [2,5] — funnel needs ~2s build-up; two frames let the scorer read the sweep/rotation

r2 (2026-07-19, forensics): helix pitch was 52px/coil (angRev 12, 630px/s climb) vs ~3px particle wall -> discrete slinky coils, the sole failing criterion. angRev 28 + hPer 2.5 = 18px pitch, below wall thickness (size 3.2 + size-random 55 + turbulence 50, opacity 45, life 2.3 for concurrent turns). Turbulence is non-monotonic: 95 shreds, ~50 blends (iter3 evidence). If coils still read: add 2nd instance with y+=11 half-pitch interleave.

r3 (2026-07-19): coil-fusion via emitter GEOMETRY not turbulence. Point emitter (0782=1) spawns every particle at the exact moving helix point -> thin discrete bands (Emitter Size is IGNORED for Point). Switch to Box (0782=2) + Emitter Size 6x22x6: each instant spawns a short vertical box that overlaps the ~18px pitch, fusing the spring into a continuous wall while X/Z=6 keeps rotation legible. Camera to 3/4 angle for the perspective the scorer found subdued.

r4 (2026-07-19): scorer at 5/10 credited rotation+dust+taper; residue = diagonal spiral bands + 'pinched lobes'. Lobes = triangle-wave emitter DWELLING at up/down turnarounds (velocity->0 => density pileup). Fix: constant-speed sawtooth climb (uniform density, no bulges). Banding: raise Turbulence SCALE (0715=32) not magnitude to break striation grain; keep tight helix (scorer's 'fewer revs' is the non-monotonic trap — wider pitch reintroduces coils).

r5 (2026-07-19): 6/10 residue fixes. (1) reframe yB640/yT150 + camera pull to -1650 = margin top&bottom (no clip). (2) base radius rB 10->20 + psec 14000 kills the bright pinpoint clump. (3) Velocity-from-Emitter-Motion 0013=16 imparts the emitter's fast tangential sweep to particles => tangential motion-blur streaks => legible rotation without reintroducing coils. (4) camera 3/4 + elevated (880,320) reveals elliptical cross-section for 3D depth.

r6 (2026-07-19): reverted r5's two overreaches — camera 3/4-elevated foreshortened funnel into a disc, and Velocity-from-Motion 16 flung the wall into diffuse dust+foreground bokeh. Restored upright camera; kept the safe r5 wins (base rB20 + psec14000 kill the bright clump, yT150/yB640 reframe). Accept moderate perspective; rotation reads from t2-vs-t5 delta + the translucent volume's near/far walls.
intent: 荒野上的龙卷风：漏斗状的烟尘柱旋转，带 3D 透视感
pass_criteria: vertical funnel/column of particles, wider top narrower base (or readable taper)
dense enough to read as a coherent volume, not a coil/spring
3D perspective feel (camera looking at the funnel, not flat 2D)
name: eval-e15

params: Emitter Type (Box: enables Emitter Size so each spawn fills a vertical segment)
Emitter Size X (thin: keep helix crisp laterally)
Emitter Size Y (~pitch: bridges coils into a wall — THE coil-fusion fix)
Turbulence Scale (finer noise breaks the diagonal helix grain)
expressions: var angRev=22.0;var climb=2.2;var p=(time/climb)%1;var ang=time*angRev*2*Math.PI;var yB=640,yT=150;var y=yB+(yT-yB)*p;var rB=20,rT=150;var r=rB+(rT-rB)*Math.pow(p,0.75);[640+r*Math.sin(ang),y,r*Math.cos(ang)]
Emitter Position (r4: constant-climb sawtooth — no turnaround dwell => no density bulges; 48 revs/pass + box fuse => smooth funnel)

_eval_result.note: Box-emitter coil-fusion SOLVED the spring (the sole failing criterion at round-1's 7/4/7). Scorer is unstable on this frame class (5/6/7 across identical-config runs). Residual: taper-vs-cylinder + rotation-legibility + perspective are mutually-trading complaints at the headless 2-still ceiling for a swept-point dust vortex. Durable win = reusable technique: Box emitter (0782=2) + Emitter Size Y ~= helix pitch fuses swept-helix coils into a continuous wall; constant-climb sawtooth (no triangle dwell) kills density bulges.
